title: Spider-Man: Shibuya Cross Line
description: A series of murders suddenly breaks out in the suburbs of Toukyou. High school student Hachidori Haruto, who gains the powers of Spider-Man after being bitten by a spider in a shrine, investigates the case and encounters Daredevil, a lawyer-hero who fights evil that cannot be punished by law. Furthermore, a ruthless figure burning with revenge attacks the two of them...
author: tokitokoro
